decisions.decision: Lead with an immediate benefit-focused sales message and a lightweight editorial collage of real local theme previews. Keep the established ink, soft-white, and purple palette; use solid surfaces, restrained motion, compact radii, and direct conversion paths.

Use a centered, text-first hero with two conversion actions and concise purchase benefits. Remove hero imagery and media preloads so the headline becomes the largest contentful element and can render without waiting for image decoding.

Align the header, landing sections, and footer to a shared 1180px responsive content line. Use reversible opacity-and-translate scroll reveals below the hero, while keeping the hero immediately visible and honoring reduced-motion preferences.

Use transparent, borderless theme cards with taller rounded previews and a 12px horizontal content inset. Video thumbnails stay still until pointer hover, then play muted and loop; reduced-motion preferences disable hover playback. Keep action-button borders neutral gray.

Use one compact, fully transparent and borderless header across home and inner marketplace pages, without a shell shadow or backdrop blur. Keep contextual light-on-dark colors over the home hero, public catalog access visible, admin navigation contrast explicit, and a complete mobile navigation panel instead of hiding primary links.
Default analytics to the current calendar day. Keep preset periods compact in one select, place Pick range last, and reveal constrained start/end date fields only for that custom option.
